record.paper_title: Some Open Questions in Analysis for Dirichlet Series
record.original_question: For 0 < p < 2, characterize the Carleson measures for the Hardy space H^p of Dirichlet series on the half-plane {Re s > 1/2}.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.2. Characterize Carleson measures for Hp on {Re s > 1/2} for p < 2.

artifact.category_tag: Carleson measures for Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{C}_{1/2} = \{ s \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{Re} s > 1/2 \}$. For an exponent $p$ with $0 < p < \infty$, define the Hardy space $\mathcal{H}^p$ of Dirichlet series as the completion of the space of Dirichlet polynomials $f(s) = \sum_{n=1}^{N} a_n n^{-s}$ with respect to the norm
$$\|f\|_{\mathcal{H}^p} = \left( \lim_{T	o\infty}  rac{1}{2T} \int_{-T}^{T} |f(it)|^p \, dt ight)^{1/p}.$$
Equivalently, via the Bohr correspondence $n^{-s} \leftrightarrow z^{\kappa(n)}$ (where $\kappa(n)$ is the multi-index of prime exponents of $n$), $\mathcal{H}^p$ is identified isometrically with the Hardy space $H^p(\mathbb{T}^\infty)$ of the infinite-dimensional polytorus. Every $f \in \mathcal{H}^p$ has an analytic extension to the half-plane $\mathbb{C}_{1/2}$.

A positive Borel measure $\mu$ on $\mathbb{C}_{1/2}$ is called a Carleson measure for $\mathcal{H}^p$ if there exists a constant $C(\mu) > 0$ such that
$$\int_{\mathbb{C}_{1/2}} |f(s)|^p \, d\mu(s) \le C(\mu) \, \|f\|_{\mathcal{H}^p}^p \qquad 	ext{for every } f \in \mathcal{H}^p.$$

Problem. For each $p$ with $0 < p < 2$, give an intrinsic geometric characterization of those positive Borel measures $\mu$ on $\mathbb{C}_{1/2}$ that are Carleson measures for $\mathcal{H}^p$.
artifact.status_search_result: No source found in the search establishes a complete characterization of Carleson measures for $\mathcal{H}^p$ on $\{\operatorname{Re} s > 1/2\}$ for $0<p<2$. Related work (e.g., on area operators and Volterra operators on $\mathcal{H}^p$) gives sufficient conditions or treats specific operator-theoretic consequences, but the intrinsic characterization problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Volterra operators on Hardy spaces of Dirichlet series
status_evidence.snippet: if μ is a Carleson measure on C₀, then for 0<p<∞, the area operator is bounded from the Hardy space H^p of Dirichlet series ... to some L^p-space.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work uses Carleson-measure conditions as sufficient hypotheses for boundedness of operators on H^p, but does not give a full characterization of Carleson measures for H^p when p<2.

status_evidence.title: Carleson measures for Hilbert spaces of analytic functions on the complex half-plane
status_evidence.snippet: necessary or sufficient conditions obtained by performing tests on reproducing kernels...
status_evidence.claim: Characterizations are pursued primarily for Hilbert (p=2) spaces; the p<2 case for Dirichlet series Hardy spaces is not addressed.
